description: Measure the input space — outputs Area, Perimeter, vertex count and the vertex list.
instructions:
Measures the input Space. Forwards the polygon unchanged on the main output (so it can sit inline in a pipeline) and exposes four value outputs: `val-area` (m²), `val-perimeter` (m), `val-vertices` (count) and `val-points` — the vertex LIST as [[x,y],…] metre pairs.

Wire `val-points` into a Vertices node (to carry the list on) or a Polygon node (to draw it). The list is CENTROID-RELATIVE (metres), matching how every 2D primitive draws local to its anchor — so the shape is preserved and lands on the consumer's anchor.

TIP: wire val-area into a Math node (e.g. area ÷ target → count), or into an Output node's Metrics.
